primary_scoring_rule.scale_definition: s_n = max(std_train_n, s_floor) fitted strictly on training-fold animals
primary_scoring_rule.trial_loss: e_{w,c,m} = mean_{(n,t) in valid_post} ((y_true[n,t] - y_pred[n,t]) / s_n[n])^2
primary_scoring_rule.worm_loss: L_w = equal-weight mean across non-buffer stimulus conditions c of mean_m e_{w,c,m}
primary_scoring_rule.dataset_loss: E_d = equal-weight mean across unique physical animals w of L_w
primary_scoring_rule.macro_gain: I_macro = equal-weight mean of I_d across unexposed main immobilized sources [seyedolmohadesin2025, toyoshima2024]
primary_scoring_rule.buffer_control_handling: Events with is_control=True or is_buffer_control=True are excluded from primary E_d and scored separately in buffer_E_d
primary_scoring_rule.sensor_glitch_filter: Frames outside [p0.1_train - 15*IQR_train, p99.9_train + 15*IQR_train] derived strictly from training-fold observed traces are masked as tracking/CFP->0 division glitches identically across all models and standalone scorer (zero dataset_id branches, zero future/val leakage)
